description:
Aggregate KPIs broken down by one dimension: product_type, sales_channel, fulfillment_provider, product, variant, or hold_reason. Rows are sorted for display; overflow past the limit folds into an "(everything else)" row so totals still reconcile. Requires an Advanced Analytics plan. Read-only.

[#127113]

currency.description: Reporting currency (e.g. "USD"). Currencies are segmented, never summed.

dimension.description: The dimension to break down by (required).

end.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit to default to today (UTC).

limit.description: Max rows before folding the rest into "(everything else)" (default 50).

start.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit to default to 30 days before end.

store.description: Store uuid to narrow to one store. Omit for all accessible stores.

workspace.description: Workspace uuid to scope to (agency accounts). Omit for the Default workspace.

name: analytics_breakdown
